lines.text: Honeydew! What's up?
Guess who's here.
Your dad!
He drove his R.V. all the way up from Cocoa Beach.
Hey, Son, working hard?
He's gonna say "Hardly working."
I meant to tell you he was driving out.
- Did he say it? - Oh, yeah.
Good kid.
He wasn't supposed to show up for a few more days.
Well, guess what he brought us.
A dog... to keep.
Yes! Yes.
Yes, I should have told Claire about the dog,
and I was going to.
But I was just waiting for her to be in the right mood.
Actually, I did get one right mood a couple nights ago,
but I cashed that in for something else.
- Am I in trouble? - Oh, really, really big.
Okay, I'm a little scared. How bad is this?
Oh, well we have a new rule- no sleeping in the bedroom.
Mr. Pritchett. Uh, Ben- Ben Dugan.
I went to high school with Mitch.
We were in the drama club together.
- That's right. - Yeah.
Geez, I didn't recognize you
without that old-guy makeup on.
You know, you and Mitch knocked The Sunshine Boys out of the park.
Mitch was really great in that.
I always thought he should be an actor.
Yeah, he's got a real job now.
He's a lawyer. How about you?
- Still acting. - Fantastic.
Actually, it's exciting. I'm in a new movie,
Maple Drive. Just came out.
You're kidding me. Look at me. I know somebody famous.
Uh, anyway, I got to go.
- Great to see you. - Good to see you too.
Kid's a movie star.
- Hey, how'd it go in there? - No cavities.
And I got a free toothbrush.
Hey, you want to go to the movies?
I just heard about a good one.
But I'm supposed to be in school.
Well, you're supposed to floss too,
but you got away with that one.
Come on. Let's go.
One of the greatest days of my life...
was when my old man sprung me from school
and took me to the track.
I wanted to do the same type of thing for Manny,
plus I figured when Gloria heard about it,
maybe it pays off in the bedroom.
I wonder if that's why my old man did it.
Oh, crap.
Your mother-in-law just had to have the dog.
Turns out she's allergic.
And the pet store didn't have a grace period
or a return policy or anything?
I got him from the pound.
Was there a twister in Kansas?
'Cause there's a house in my driveway.
Welcome home, Mr. Dunphy.
Uh, always a pleasure, Mr. Dunphy.
Indeed it is, Mr. Dunphy. Place it there.
- Oh, I shall. I shall. - I miss this. Get in here.
My dad is awesome.
He's awesome. He's always up. He's always happy.
I mean, he and I are best buds.
We're like two peas in a pod.
Or Siamese twins. Or a snake with two heads.
- They've actually been all those things for Halloween. - Yeah.
Oy. This must be Scout, huh?
I should warn you. He sheds.
I made the mistake of letting him sleep with me on the road.
Now my sheets look like two bigfoots did it.
Pardon the language.
- How's Mom? - Speaking of big feet, eh?
She's on a cruise with her girlfriends,
some of which are not totally unattractive.
Oh, that reminds me. She sent some gifts for the kids.
Um, I will be right back.
- You three get better acquainted. - Will do!
- Bye! - Will do!
I cannot believe you got a dog without consulting me.
This was a major family decision.
- It was wrong. - Yeah.
And I'm sorry.
But we have talked about getting a dog for years,
and you're the only one who wasn't into it.
Because I knew that I would be the one taking care of it.
That's not true.
No, we will all help.
This is a great chance to teach the kids responsibility.
That is exactly what you said about Luke's paper route.
Hello?
Is anyone in there?
Red's a good color on you.
It's just a movie.
- Oh, he's so cute. - Look at his little face.
I always wanted a dog. Thanks, Grandpa.
Okay, but remember, having a dog is a major responsibility.
Everyone in the family has to pitch in.
- Can do, Mrs. D. - Not you, Dylan.
Oh, phew. 'Cause I got a lot on my plate right now.
Hey, look who's here. Uncle Cam.
Hey, we heard about the new addition
and we had to come right over.
Cameron, so good to see you again.
Now that is a shirt.
Oh, well, thank you, Frank. I get 'em online.
I'll send you a link.
Oh, well, at home, I smoke sausages.
I'll send you a link.
Classic.
- And this must be Lily. - Oh, yes.
She just couldn't wait to meet the new doggy.
I think she's good right here.
Let me get in there and get some of that doggyness.
- Oh, there it is. - Haley.
- There it is. - I gotta go.
- What's wrong? - That was Brian. He just quit the band.
What? Why?
He's moving to Portland.
His parents got back together.
- Oh, that sucks. - I know.
Now we're gonna have to cancel the gig tomorrow.
Maybe you can find another drummer.
No. I think it's too late for that now.
I play drums.
Well, I mean, I haven't played in a while, since Lily's come along,
but if you're in a jam, I can jam.
Well, I totally would, but I'm not sure
we like the same sorts of music, you know?
What, because I'm gay,
I'm just gonna want to play show tunes?
No, because you're old.
Wow. That hurt more, Dylan.
Give him a chance. It's better than canceling.
You're right. I don't want to lose
the deposit on that fog machine.
Okay. Let's do it.
I used to be a music teacher,
but I gave that up as soon as Lily came along.
Yes. Well, we just felt that it was really important...
that one of us stayed hometo raise her, so-
Yeah, and that's not a judgmenton other people's choices.
It's just that we happen to be a very traditional family.
Yes, that's what the disabled lesbian shaman
who blessed Lily's room said too.
How you doin', buddy?
All right, relax.
Oh, geez.
I am telling you, Phil, the man was crying.
That is impossible.
My dad is the happiest guy on earth.
It probably just sounded like he was crying.
Have you heard the noise he makes when he gets out of a chair?
No. I know what I heard.
I think this has something to do with your mom.
- What? - Yeah, he came here alone. Think about it.
She's on a cruise.
Yeah, and they never take separate vacations, so-
No. No, if something was wrong,
my dad would tell me about it.
No, Phil, he wouldn't,
because you guys never actually talk about anything.
We talk all the time.
He crank calls me at work, like, three times a week.
- Crank calls don't count. - Counts for fun.
No, honestly, I think that you should
find out what's going on with your dad.
It's going to be nothing.
My dad isn't like your dad.
There's nothing deep and dark inside.
His hard candy shell is just hiding more candy.
I think he wants to go out. Good boy.
- Smart dog. - I hate to break it to you,
but I think all dogs can do that.
I'm gonna play outside.
What happened?
Okay.
Should I just play a little something?
Yeah. But, you know, if it doesn't work out,
don't feel bad.
Well, hopefully this is- this is like riding a bicycle,
and it'll all come back to me.
That's the loud one.
So... here we go.
Oh, silly me.
I had the sticks in the wrong hands.
Dude, you should label those sticks.
Is that the alarm? Has our perimeter been breached?
It's not the alarm. The doorbell won't stop ringing.
- Maybe a demon is ringing it. - Not a demon.
Who keeps ringing the doorbell?
- We're pretty sure it's a demon. - Oh, yeah?
There.
If it were a demon, it would keep on ringing.
Not if he's already inside. I'm getting a weapon.
What were you thinking?
Who takes a little boy to a horror movie?
That's loco, Jay.
This is no big deal. You want scary?
When I was his age,
I lived through the Cuban Missile Crisis.
I slept with a butter knife under my pillow...
in case I had to fight some Soviet colonel.
Why would they send a Soviet colonel to get a little boy?
Because I could identify every commie plane.
What are we talking about?
Look, all I'm saying, being scared is part of growing up.
Manny will get over this. It builds character.
I'll take the first watch.
You two might as well get some rest.
It's gonna be a long night.
Character.
Dad?
Come on in! It's open!
Don't tell me. You need a cup of sugar.
Nah. Just, uh-
I was just wondering, I don't know, uh-
Anything on the old noodle?
Other than a bad toupee?
I'm kidding, of course. This is my real hair.
- Well, okay. - Wait a minute.
I want to ask you something.
Am I putting you in a bad position with this whole dog thing?
Claire seemed a little put out.
Oh, don't worry about it. Claire didn't like me at first either.
I can't blame her. Dismissed!
Oh, Dad, um, you know what? I, uh-
Claire saw something,
and she'd kill me if I- if I didn't ask.
What is it?
Would you wear pants to breakfast, for crying out loud?
- You got me again. Right in the funny bone. - All right.
Come on, Scout. Let go of it.
No, no, no!
Dog. Look at this.
How did he get ahold of your bra?
Well, uh, we were out on a date,
and he has a really nice car, so-
How do you think? He got it out of the laundry basket.
Can't take my eyes off that dog for a second.
Why don't you just keep him in the crate?
I tried that. He figured out how to get out.
I thought you were dealing with your dad.
Oh, yeah, I did. He's fine, so-
You got that from a two-minute conversation?
I... asked him point-blank if he was okay.
He said he was. So I just-
Just swapped some jokes and moved on.
Phil, the man needs more of a push than that.
Look, if he wants to talk to me about it, he will.
Geez, someone's panties are in a bunch.
- I thought I was showing concern and- - No. Right there.
Oh, my God! That damn dog!
Guys, little help?
I have to go to the bathroom, and I'm not gonna do it in here.
- Hey, I got Chinese. - Sweet! I'm starving.
Oh, we have guests.
Yeah. We're just having a little jam session.
You know Dylan. This is Craig. This is Neil.
I'll always remember him as the stranger holding my baby.
Can I talk to you in the kitchen for a second?
Yeah. Hey, guys, let's, uh- let's just take five.
What's up with 21 Jump Street?
Oh, well, their drummer quit
and I'm gonna fill in for him tomorrow night.
No, no. We have Pepper's
apres-ski fondue party tomorrow night, Cam.
Oh, no.
So you'll just have to tell your band
that they're gonna have to find someone else.
You know what? No. I'm not gonna let these fellas down.
I made a commitment.
You made two commitments, okay?
And you know how Pepper is.
Everything has to be perfect.
He gets mad if you don't wear a big sweater.
Yeah, I remember. I got so hot last year,
I almost went face down in the gruyere.
So I'm going by myself, is that what you're saying?
I just feel like I kind of need this.
To round out your college applications?
It's just that because I'm always home with Lily...
I just feel like I'm going a little bit stir-crazy.
Look at the den.
Every time I finish painting it, I start all over again.
It's like the Golden Gate Bridge.
I'm gonna go back to jamming.
Yeah, we gotta fix this.
Hey, what's with the big sweater at a concert?
Is that a gay thing?
No, Dad. It's for my friend Pepper's apres-ski fondue-
Yeah. Yeah, it's a gay thing.
Hope they start soon.
I don't think Scout likes to be left alone.
You love the dog.
No, I don't love the dog. I love my couch.
And the dog was looking at it like it was a giant sausage.
Good news, you two. You're getting your driveway back.
- I'm hitting the open road in the morning. - Oh, already?
- Yeah. - Anxious to get home and see Mom, huh?
No, I'm just gonna drive wherever the wind blows me,
which is usually into the next lane.
Can we get some sodas, Grandpa?
Okay, but just one. I'm driving. Come on.
He's not going home? He's never been away from my mom
for longer than a doctor's appointment.
Honey, I know. I told you.
I always felt bad for people
with emotionally distant fathers.
It turns out I'm one of 'em.
It's a miracle I didn't end up a stripper.
Thanks, everybody, for coming out.
These are some songs we wrote.
One, two. One, two, three.
* Baby, don't leave me I just want you to know *
* I want you to know *
* There's something inside me that I cannot control *
* I cannot control *
- Our boyfriends totally rock! - I know, right?
* I heard you screamin' my name I'm goin' insane *
Well, the plan was...
to watch him for 10 minutes
and then run out to Pepper's party.
* Coursing through my veins *
But he was so great up there.
How-How could I leave?
* But don't be afraid *
* I'll be your vampire *
It was his moment.
I know!
And his moment went on for a really, really long time.
Turns out I could have run to the party
and made it back for the end of his moment.
Manny, go brush your teeth and get ready for bed, okay?
- Your bed. - Can I watch TV?
- Mmm, only 10 minutes. - Okay.
Hey, Jay, it's Ben Dugan.
I got your message.
Uh, yes, I'm happy to help out. I'll swing by tonight.
- What's that? - That's Ben.
That's the guy who was in the movie.
I figure when Manny sees him, sees how nice he is,
he'll realize it's all pretend.
- You think that will work? - Guy's a sweetheart.
Manny's gonna spend two minutes with him.
He'll explain how the movie's made.
He's even bringing his fake machete.
Thing's made of rubber.
Hey, are you Manny? I'm here for you.
Look what I got.
Mom, he's here!
Que paso? Que paso? Que paso?
We're gonna need a bigger bed!
Oh, geez.
Oh, my God! I think that's him.
- You stayed. - Yeah.
Well, you know, I'm-I'm with the band.
I thought the gig was a little sloppy in spots,
but I think once I learn all the songs-
I thought- I thought this was a one-time thing?
Are you kidding? We destroyed in there.
Did you hear that one lady screaming my name?
That was Phil. He had a Red Bull.
Hey, guys. Good gig, huh?
- Yeah. Totally awesome, man. - Heck of a gig.
Hey, guys.
Hey. I thought you were in Portland.
No. My parents broke up again.
I'm not moving. I can stay in the band.
Well, this is awkward.
Cam.
Oh, awkward for me.
Good luck following that, Ringo.
I believe this belongs to you.
I don't want to drag the house along with me.
Come here, you little monkeys.
Bye, Grandpa. We'll miss you.
I wish I could take you with me.
- Drive safe, Grandpa. - Oh, I'll try.
You sure you don't want to stay for breakfast?
No, I ought to be hitting the road.
Well, adios.
Dad, hold on.
- Can I talk to you for a second? - Sure.
Guys. Come on.
I don't think you're being honest with me.
I- I know something is going on with you.
What's up?
Something up? Well, my boxers are, uh, riding a little high.
I'm not in the mood for jokes right now,
- although you nailed that. - Thanks.
- Great stuff. - Thanks.
- It's nothing. - Oh, it's nothing?
- Nothing to do with Mom? - No!
Well, yeah. I've fallen in love.
Oh, my God.
- Who is she? - He!
What?
It's that little guy right over there.
Come on over here. Come on. Come on.
There you go. Ah, look at him.
Driving across country,
this little bastard nuzzled his way
right into my heart, didn't ya?
So this is just about you not wanting to leave the dog?
Well, you should tell Mom.
Those three days on the road with him
were the happiest of my life.
You should leave that part out.
I don't want to keep Scout if it makes Grandpa sad.
Yeah, I know, sweetie. But Grandma has allergies,
so Scout has to stay with us.
Well, she could always just get some allergy shots.
Honey, you don't want to put her through that.
Hell, back in the day, I got a vasectomy for her.
Dad. Dad. Please.
Scout's- Scout's your dog.
He should go with you.
Okay, you twisted my arm.
Thanks, Son. Thanks for poking through the armor.
- You're poking through the armor down there. - What?
Made you look.
You are a treasure.
Come on, Scout. Let's mosey.
Oh, oh, oh! Oh, wait.
- He loves that, yeah. - Oh, I bet he does.
No, Scout. This time I drive.
You still got it!
I can't believe I'm saying this,
but I think I might have actually gotten even closer with my dad.
I can't believe he took my dog.
- Bye-bye. - Bye, Grandpa! Love you!
Bye, Dad.
- Bye, Grandpa! I love you! - Luke, stay!
-Luke, stay! - Come back soon! I'll see you later!
Luke, stay!
- Luke! - Stay!
Frank.
Hey, Jay. Good to see you.
Great to see you. Didn't expect to find you here.
Well, listen, when my granddaughter's boyfriend's band
plays an under-21 club with my daughter-in-law's
brother's gay partner, I show up.
That's just how I was raised.
- I don't think you met my wife, Gloria. - Hola.
Oh, it's a pleasure. You are a lovely woman.
- You must be Frank. - Okay, then,
you are hotter than a Las Vegas sidewalk on the Fourth of July.
- Did I go too far? - Not you, Frank. No.

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Honeydew! What's up?
segments.translation: 宝贝儿 找我什么事

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Guess who's here.
segments.translation: 猜猜谁来了

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Your dad!
segments.translation: 是你爸

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: He drove his R.V. all the way up from Cocoa Beach.
segments.translation: 他从可可海滩一路开着房车过来的

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Hey, Son, working hard?
segments.translation: 儿子啊 在努力工作吗

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: He's gonna say "Hardly working."
segments.translation: 他会说 工作个屁

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: I meant to tell you he was driving out.
segments.translation: 我原本是打算告诉你他出发的事

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: - Did he say it? - Oh, yeah.
segments.translation: -他说了吗 -说了

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Good kid.
segments.translation: 好孩子

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: He wasn't supposed to show up for a few more days.
segments.translation: 他本该过几天才到的

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Well, guess what he brought us.
segments.translation: 猜猜他给我们带了什么来

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: A dog... to keep.
segments.translation: 一只狗 给我们养的

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Yes! Yes.
segments.translation: 没错 没错

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Yes, I should have told Claire about the dog,
segments.translation: 没错 我早该把狗的事告诉克莱尔

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: and I was going to.
segments.translation: 我本来准备说的

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: But I was just waiting for her to be in the right mood.
segments.translation: 我只是想等她心情好时再说

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Actually, I did get one right mood a couple nights ago,
segments.translation: 其实 几天前的某晚她心情就挺好

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: but I cashed that in for something else.
segments.translation: 可我用那晚"干"了其他的事

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: - Am I in trouble? - Oh, really, really big.
segments.translation: -我是不是有大麻烦了 -非常非常大

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Okay, I'm a little scared. How bad is this?
segments.translation: 你吓到我了 到底有多糟

segments.sceneTitle: 宝贝儿 找我什么事
segments.text: Oh, well we have a new rule- no sleeping in the bedroom.
segments.translation: 我们家立了新规矩 不许进卧室

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Mr. Pritchett. Uh, Ben- Ben Dugan.
segments.translation: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: I went to high school with Mitch.
segments.translation: 我是米奇的高中同学

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: We were in the drama club together.
segments.translation: 我们一起参加过戏剧社

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: - That's right. - Yeah.
segments.translation: -想起来了 -是的

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Geez, I didn't recognize you
segments.translation: 老天 你卸了老头子妆

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: without that old-guy makeup on.
segments.translation: 我都认不出你了

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: You know, you and Mitch knocked The Sunshine Boys out of the park.
segments.translation: 你和米奇演的《阳光小子》火爆全场

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Mitch was really great in that.
segments.translation: 米奇演得很棒

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: I always thought he should be an actor.
segments.translation: 我一直觉得他是当演员的料

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Yeah, he's got a real job now.
segments.translation: 他现在找了份真正的工作

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: He's a lawyer. How about you?
segments.translation: 他做了律师 你呢

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: - Still acting. - Fantastic.
segments.translation: -我还在演戏 -那敢情好

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Actually, it's exciting. I'm in a new movie,
segments.translation: 其实挺过瘾的 我演了部新电影

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Maple Drive. Just came out.
segments.translation: 《枫叶大道》 刚上映的

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: You're kidding me. Look at me. I know somebody famous.
segments.translation: 真的吗 哇 我认识名人了

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Uh, anyway, I got to go.
segments.translation: 那我先走了

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: - Great to see you. - Good to see you too.
segments.translation: -见到你真高兴 -我也是

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Kid's a movie star.
segments.translation: 这孩子成电影明星了

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: - Hey, how'd it go in there? - No cavities.
segments.translation: -医生怎么说 -没有蛀牙

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: And I got a free toothbrush.
segments.translation: 我还得了把免费牙刷

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: Hey, you want to go to the movies?
segments.translation: 嘿 你想去看电影吗

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: I just heard about a good one.
segments.translation: 我刚听说一部好片子

segments.sceneTitle: 普里契特先生 我是本 本·杜根
segments.text: But I'm supposed to be in school.
segments.translation: 可我该去上学了

segments.translation: 哎呀 我真傻

segments.sceneTitle: 天啊
segments.text: I had the sticks in the wrong hands.
segments.translation: 我把鼓槌给拿反了

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Dude, you should label those sticks.
segments.translation: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Is that the alarm? Has our perimeter been breached?
segments.translation: 这是警报吗 我们家被入侵了吗

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: It's not the alarm. The doorbell won't stop ringing.
segments.translation: 不是警报 是门铃停不下来了

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: - Maybe a demon is ringing it. - Not a demon.
segments.translation: -也许是魔鬼在按门铃 -才没有魔鬼

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Who keeps ringing the doorbell?
segments.translation: 谁老是在按门铃啊

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: - We're pretty sure it's a demon. - Oh, yeah?
segments.translation: -肯定是魔鬼在按 -是吗

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: There.
segments.translation: 现在呢

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: If it were a demon, it would keep on ringing.
segments.translation: 如果是魔鬼 它就会继续响了

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Not if he's already inside. I'm getting a weapon.
segments.translation: 除非他已经进屋了 我要去武装起来

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: What were you thinking?
segments.translation: 你脑子里想什么呢

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Who takes a little boy to a horror movie?
segments.translation: 带这么小的孩子去看恐怖片

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: That's loco, Jay.
segments.translation: 你疯了吗 杰

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: This is no big deal. You want scary?
segments.translation: 有什么大不了的 你知道什么才恐怖吗

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: When I was his age,
segments.translation: 我像他这么大时

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I lived through the Cuban Missile Crisis.
segments.translation: 可是经历过古巴导弹危机的

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I slept with a butter knife under my pillow...
segments.translation: 我睡觉时都藏把黄油刀在枕头下

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: in case I had to fight some Soviet colonel.
segments.translation: 以防要和苏联上校搏斗

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Why would they send a Soviet colonel to get a little boy?
segments.translation: 苏联上校抓你个小屁孩干什么

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Because I could identify every commie plane.
segments.translation: 因为我能认出苏共的每一架飞机

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: What are we talking about?
segments.translation: 我们这是在说什么呢

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Look, all I'm saying, being scared is part of growing up.
segments.translation: 我的意思是 恐惧也是成长的一部分

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Manny will get over this. It builds character.
segments.translation: 曼尼会没事的 那有助于培养个性

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I'll take the first watch.
segments.translation: 我站第一班岗

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: You two might as well get some rest.
segments.translation: 你们俩最好先去睡一下

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: It's gonna be a long night.
segments.translation: 长夜漫漫啊

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Character.
segments.translation: 有个性吧

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Dad?
segments.translation: 爸

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Come on in! It's open!
segments.translation: 进来吧 门没锁

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Don't tell me. You need a cup of sugar.
segments.translation: 别说你是上隔壁借白糖来了

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Nah. Just, uh-
segments.translation: 不 我只是

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I was just wondering, I don't know, uh-
segments.translation: 我只是觉得 那个

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Anything on the old noodle?
segments.translation: 您脑子里没在烦恼什么事吧

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Other than a bad toupee?
segments.translation: 除了这顶烂假发吗

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I'm kidding, of course. This is my real hair.
segments.translation: 我开玩笑的 这可是真头发

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: - Well, okay. - Wait a minute.
segments.translation: -好吧 -等一下

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I want to ask you something.
segments.translation: 我有事问你

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Am I putting you in a bad position with this whole dog thing?
segments.translation: 我把狗带来是不是让你为难了

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Claire seemed a little put out.
segments.translation: 克莱尔看起来不太高兴

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Oh, don't worry about it. Claire didn't like me at first either.
segments.translation: 别理她 克莱尔一开始还不喜欢我呢

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: I can't blame her. Dismissed!
segments.translation: 那也不怪她 解散

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Oh, Dad, um, you know what? I, uh-
segments.translation: 爸 你知道吗 我...

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: Claire saw something,
segments.translation: 克莱尔撞见了一件事

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: and she'd kill me if I- if I didn't ask.
segments.translation: 要是我不问你 她非灭了我

segments.sceneTitle: 老兄 你该给鼓槌贴好左右标签
segments.text: What is it?
segments.translation: 什么事

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Would you wear pants to breakfast, for crying out loud?
segments.translation: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真叫人"哭"笑不得

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: - You got me again. Right in the funny bone. - All right.
segments.translation: -又被你骗到了 正中弱点 -很好

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Come on, Scout. Let go of it.
segments.translation: 拜托 斯科特 松口

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: No, no, no!
segments.translation: 别 别

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Dog. Look at this.
segments.translation: 坏狗狗 你看这个

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: How did he get ahold of your bra?
segments.translation: 他怎么会有你的胸罩

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Well, uh, we were out on a date,
segments.translation: 我们出去约会

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: and he has a really nice car, so-
segments.translation: 他有辆特别好的车 于是

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: How do you think? He got it out of the laundry basket.
segments.translation: 你以为呢 当然是从洗衣篮里找到的

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Can't take my eyes off that dog for a second.
segments.translation: 对这狗一秒钟也不能大意

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Why don't you just keep him in the crate?
segments.translation: 干嘛不把它关笼子里

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: I tried that. He figured out how to get out.
segments.translation: 我关了 他自己会开笼子

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: I thought you were dealing with your dad.
segments.translation: 你不是去找你爸谈话了吗

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Oh, yeah, I did. He's fine, so-
segments.translation: 没错 我们谈了 他没事

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: You got that from a two-minute conversation?
segments.translation: 你们才谈两分钟就谈好了吗

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: I... asked him point-blank if he was okay.
segments.translation: 我直接问他还好吗

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: He said he was. So I just-
segments.translation: 他说很好 所以我就

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Just swapped some jokes and moved on.
segments.translation: 结果你们扯了几个笑话 就谈完了

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Phil, the man needs more of a push than that.
segments.translation: 菲尔 你得更深入地问他

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Look, if he wants to talk to me about it, he will.
segments.translation: 如果他想谈 他会主动说的

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Geez, someone's panties are in a bunch.
segments.translation: 有人的内裤搅成一团了

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: - I thought I was showing concern and- - No. Right there.
segments.translation: -我只想表示一下关心 -不 你看

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Oh, my God! That damn dog!
segments.translation: 我的天 这该死的狗

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: Guys, little help?
segments.translation: 二位 帮帮忙啊

segments.sceneTitle: 你吃早饭时就不能穿条裤子吗 真…
segments.text: I have to go to the bathroom, and I'm not gonna do it in here.
segments.translation: 我要上厕所了 我可不想尿裤子

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: - Hey, I got Chinese. - Sweet! I'm starving.
segments.translation: -我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿着呢

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Oh, we have guests.
segments.translation: 有客人呀

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Yeah. We're just having a little jam session.
segments.translation: 我们正合奏呢

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: You know Dylan. This is Craig. This is Neil.
segments.translation: 迪兰你认识的 那边是克雷格和尼尔

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: I'll always remember him as the stranger holding my baby.
segments.translation: 我会记得他是抱着我女儿的陌生人

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Can I talk to you in the kitchen for a second?
segments.translation: 你能到厨房来一下吗

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Yeah. Hey, guys, let's, uh- let's just take five.
segments.translation: 好的 各位 我们休息一下

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: What's up with 21 Jump Street?
segments.translation: 这支龙虎少年队怎么了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Oh, well, their drummer quit
segments.translation: 他们的鼓手退团了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: and I'm gonna fill in for him tomorrow night.
segments.translation: 我明晚帮他们顶替一下

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: No, no. We have Pepper's
segments.translation: 不 明天我们得去胡娇家的

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: apres-ski fondue party tomorrow night, Cam.
segments.translation: 滑雪风情奶酪火锅派对 小卡

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Oh, no.
segments.translation: 不是吧

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: So you'll just have to tell your band
segments.translation: 你得通知乐队

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: that they're gonna have to find someone else.
segments.translation: 另请高明了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: You know what? No. I'm not gonna let these fellas down.
segments.translation: 不 我不能失信于他们

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: I made a commitment.
segments.translation: 我答应他们了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: You made two commitments, okay?
segments.translation: 你也答应了胡娇 好吗

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: And you know how Pepper is.
segments.translation: 而你又知道胡娇那脾气

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Everything has to be perfect.
segments.translation: 凡事必须完美

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: He gets mad if you don't wear a big sweater.
segments.translation: 你不穿厚毛衣他都能跟你急

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Yeah, I remember. I got so hot last year,
segments.translation: 我记得 去年我热得要命

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: I almost went face down in the gruyere.
segments.translation: 差点晕死在奶酪上

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: So I'm going by myself, is that what you're saying?
segments.translation: 所以你是想让我一个人去吗

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: I just feel like I kind of need this.
segments.translation: 我真心需要参加这个

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: To round out your college applications?
segments.translation: 为了丰富你大学申请书吗

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: It's just that because I'm always home with Lily...
segments.translation: 我总是呆在家里守着莉莉

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: I just feel like I'm going a little bit stir-crazy.
segments.translation: 我闷得有点发疯了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Look at the den.
segments.translation: 你看看那书房

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Every time I finish painting it, I start all over again.
segments.translation: 被我翻来覆去地粉刷

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: It's like the Golden Gate Bridge.
segments.translation: 都快赶上金门大桥了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: I'm gonna go back to jamming.
segments.translation: 我要回去练习了

segments.sceneTitle: 我买了中餐外卖 -太好了 正饿…
segments.text: Yeah, we gotta fix this.
segments.translation: 得 我们必须解决这事了

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: Hey, what's with the big sweater at a concert?
segments.translation: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: Is that a gay thing?
segments.translation: 是基友们的穿衣风格吗

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: No, Dad. It's for my friend Pepper's apres-ski fondue-
segments.translation: 不 是为了胡娇的滑雪风格风奶酪火锅

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: Yeah. Yeah, it's a gay thing.
segments.translation: 好吧 的确是基友们的风格

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: Hope they start soon.
segments.translation: 最好赶紧开始

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: I don't think Scout likes to be left alone.
segments.translation: 斯科特不喜欢独守空屋

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: You love the dog.
segments.translation: 你挺喜欢那狗的嘛

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: No, I don't love the dog. I love my couch.
segments.translation: 不 不是喜欢它 我是心疼我的沙发

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: And the dog was looking at it like it was a giant sausage.
segments.translation: 那狗看沙发的眼神就跟那是巨型香肠一样

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: Good news, you two. You're getting your driveway back.
segments.translation: 孩子们 好消息 你的车道要腾空了

segments.sceneTitle: 穿厚毛衣来听演唱会
segments.text: - I'm hitting the open road in the morning. - Oh, already?
